event_memory_mapping: one Event Memory ID per Event ID in numeric order
pattern_contribution_mapping: one Pattern Contribution ID per Event ID in numeric order

pattern_candidates.label: POINT_ZERO_DRIFT
pattern_candidates.definition: A system continues operating while losing traceability to the origin condition/source that justified its current structure.

pattern_candidates.label: FAILURE_AS_ORIGIN_RECHECK_TRIGGER
pattern_candidates.definition: Observed failure or deviation should trigger re-examination of the relevant Point Zero rather than only local correction.

pattern_candidates.label: RECURSIVE_LOCAL_POINT_ZERO
pattern_candidates.definition: A Sub-Sequence may require its own scoped Point Zero while remaining linked to the parent Sequence origin.

pattern_candidates.label: REPRESENTATION_PROPERTY_ORDER_SEPARATION
pattern_candidates.definition: The existence/order of a representation label can be distinct from properties or explanatory dimensions attached to it later.

pattern_candidates.label: REVERSE_ENGINEERING_RESOLUTION_GAIN
pattern_candidates.definition: Repeated reverse tracing can increase model resolution when it exposes earlier assumptions, dependencies or omitted causes.

pattern_candidates.label: BIG_PICTURE_TO_SUBSEQUENCE_DECOMPOSITION
pattern_candidates.definition: A refined higher-level model can be decomposed into smaller Sequences after its origin/end relations are understood.

primitive_candidates.name: POINT_ZERO_TRACEBACK_GATE
primitive_candidates.definition: Before accepting a model, plan, theory or correction as sufficiently grounded, require a trace to the relevant scoped Point Zero or explicit UNKNOWN when that origin cannot yet be recovered.

primitive_candidates.name: ORIGIN_DISTANCE_MEASURE
primitive_candidates.definition: Measure the number and type of derivation, dependency or interpretation layers between a current object/claim/action and its relevant Point Zero, without treating greater distance as automatically worse.

primitive_candidates.name: RECURSIVE_LOCAL_POINT_ZERO
primitive_candidates.definition: Allow a Sub-Sequence to declare a local Point Zero while preserving a typed reference to the parent Sequence Point Zero and preventing the local origin from overwriting the global one.

primitive_candidates.name: REPRESENTATION_PROPERTY_ORDER_GUARD
primitive_candidates.definition: Keep the origin/order of a representation or label separate from properties, dimensions or explanatory structures attached to it later; do not infer that the later property caused the original label without evidence.

growth_law: The Brain count increases through durable Event memory, relations, paths, combinations, intent signatures, Pattern Contributions, Pattern Candidates and review-gated primitive candidates. The Human source parameter count is not inflated merely to force growth.
